posts.text: Unveiled the 18-ft Bharat Mata sculpture at New Vadaj Circle, Ahmedabad today. A tribute to our motherland and the civilizational values that unite 140 crore Indians. posts.text: I will sit on the CM's chair only when the people of Delhi say I am honest. Our fight is for truth, for clean governance, for every child's right to quality education. The people of Delhi know who built their schools and hospitals.

posts.text: Budget 2026 delivers for MSMEs: ₹10,000 crore SME Growth Fund, ₹2,000 crore boost for micro enterprises, and a plan to revive 200 legacy industrial clusters. Our small businesses are the backbone of India's economy — they deserve the full support of the government.

posts.text: Our Group has never retreated. After facing the most intense global scrutiny any Indian conglomerate has ever faced, we emerged stronger — with record profits and a clear vision. Visited Dholera SIR to review our infrastructure projects. India's future is being built today.

posts.text: Jio Platforms filed 6,817 patents in FY26 — 3,476 in India alone. With the IPO on the horizon, we're evaluating strategic options to fuel long-term growth in connectivity, AI, and 5G. India's digital revolution is being powered by innovation at scale.

posts.text: The values of integrity, humility, and nation-building must endure beyond any one individual. I have always believed that no success or achievement is worthwhile unless it serves as a bridge for others to cross over. Keep building India.

posts.text: Presented the Padma Awards 2026 to extraordinary individuals from every corner of our nation. These grassroots change-makers — from tribal educators to rural health workers — embody the spirit of service that defines India. Their stories are India's greatest treasure.

posts.text: Iran is negotiating on fumes. They thought they were going to outwait me. 'We'll outwait him. He's got the midterms.' I don't care about the midterms. Look what happened last night — that was the prelude. Nobody's going to control the Strait of Hormuz. It's international waters.

posts.text: The Conservative Party must offer a credible alternative built on economic competence and aspiration. We stabilized the economy, cut inflation, and grew wages. Now the task is to hold this government to account and earn back the public's trust with bold ideas.
posts.caption: The Conservative Party must offer a credible alternative built on economic competence and aspiration. We stabilized the economy, cut inflation, and grew wages. Now the task is to hold this government to account and earn back the public's trust with bold ideas.

posts.text: Honored to have President Trump's total endorsement for Governor of Ohio. We're going to bring the same energy to the state level — cut the bureaucracy, unleash growth, and put Ohio families first. Ready to be the first Indian-American governor in this great state.
posts.caption: Honored to have President Trump's total endorsement for Governor of Ohio. We're going to bring the same energy to the state level — cut the bureaucracy, unleash growth, and put Ohio families first. Ready to be the first Indian-American governor in this great state.

posts.text: Proud of the Indian-American community's contributions to this great nation. Our story — of hard work, education, and family values — is the American story at its best. Grateful to serve alongside JD in this incredible chapter.
posts.caption: Proud of the Indian-American community's contributions to this great nation. Our story — of hard work, education, and family values — is the American story at its best. Grateful to serve alongside JD in this incredible chapter.

posts.text: Restoring accountability and transparency at the FBI. The American people deserve the truth and we will deliver it. No sacred cows. The rule of law applies equally to everyone — that's the promise I made and that's the promise I'm keeping.
posts.caption: Restoring accountability and transparency at the FBI. The American people deserve the truth and we will deliver it. No sacred cows. The rule of law applies equally to everyone — that's the promise I made and that's the promise I'm keeping.

posts.text: Working with the Administration on AI policy that keeps America at the frontier of innovation. India-US tech collaboration has never been more critical. The goal: ensure AI thrives while addressing legitimate safety concerns. Exciting times ahead.
posts.caption: Working with the Administration on AI policy that keeps America at the frontier of innovation. India-US tech collaboration has never been more critical. The goal: ensure AI thrives while addressing legitimate safety concerns. Exciting times ahead.

posts.text: The World Bank is accelerating its mission to build resilience across developing nations. Climate adaptation and digital infrastructure are not separate agendas — they are two sides of the same coin for sustainable, inclusive growth.
posts.caption: The World Bank is accelerating its mission to build resilience across developing nations. Climate adaptation and digital infrastructure are not separate agendas — they are two sides of the same coin for sustainable, inclusive growth.

posts.text: This treaty is the biggest step forward in our defence and security relationship with Poland in a generation. The challenges Europe now faces demand an even stronger partnership — allowing us to confront modern security threats that may be less visible but no less dangerous.
posts.caption: This treaty is the biggest step forward in our defence and security relationship with Poland in a generation. The challenges Europe now faces demand an even stronger partnership — allowing us to confront modern security threats that may be less visible but no less dangerous.

posts.text: Welcoming Microsoft's $25 billion investment in Australia for AI and digital infrastructure. This will create thousands of jobs, boost our cybersecurity capabilities, and position Australia at the forefront of the global AI revolution. A huge vote of confidence in our nation.
posts.caption: Welcoming Microsoft's $25 billion investment in Australia for AI and digital infrastructure. This will create thousands of jobs, boost our cybersecurity capabilities, and position Australia at the forefront of the global AI revolution. A huge vote of confidence in our nation.

posts.text: This agreement with Norway establishes a principle of mutual assistance between our two countries. France's nuclear umbrella now extends to our Norwegian allies. Deeper cooperation will support Europe's ambitions for greater strategic autonomy.

posts.text: Dubai continues to set new benchmarks for the world. Our vision is to be the most future-ready city on earth — leading in AI, clean energy, and innovation. We build for tomorrow while delivering excellence today. The UAE's best days are ahead.
posts.caption: Dubai continues to set new benchmarks for the world. Our vision is to be the most future-ready city on earth — leading in AI, clean energy, and innovation. We build for tomorrow while delivering excellence today. The UAE's best days are ahead.

posts.text: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it's possible that may be what happens. This is a 180-day lease with 90 day notice mutual cancellation thereafter. The short term was our request, not Anthropic's. We won't leave them hanging but if compute gets super tight we might need it back.

posts.text: AI is the most consequential technology of our time. We're making tough decisions on headcount to move faster — 8,000 roles restructured to accelerate AI development. Massive investment in infrastructure and talent that will define the next decade. We're competing to win.
posts.caption: AI is the most consequential technology of our time. We're making tough decisions on headcount to move faster — 8,000 roles restructured to accelerate AI development. Massive investment in infrastructure and talent that will define the next decade. We're competing to win.

posts.text: Excited to address Stanford's Class of 2026. I understand the anxiety around AI — it's real and valid. But I'm optimistic that this generation will shape AI into a force for good. Also announced the Universal Commerce Protocol and new retail partnerships at NRF. We processed 90 trillion tokens in 2025.

posts.text: 2026 is the year AI moves from hype to real impact. Announcing $25 billion investment in Australia for AI and digital infrastructure. The shift is from models to systems — AI as scaffolding for human potential, not a replacement. $81.3 billion in Q2 revenue, 17% growth. We're just getting started.

posts.text: I'm delighted to be wrong about this. I thought there would have been more impact on entry-level white-collar jobs being eliminated by now than has actually happened. The human part of employment is more irreplaceable than I feared. AI won't cause a jobs apocalypse.

posts.text: Four years ago, Nvidia was spending about $10-15 billion a year in Taiwan. Now we're spending $100 billion, going to $150 billion each year. Taiwan is the epicenter of the AI revolution. Our new headquarters will break ground this year — operational by 2030. We would also be delighted to serve the China market.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure — UPI, Aadhaar, ONDC — is the model the world is now learning from. We built the rails; now the ecosystem is flourishing. The next phase is AI-powered governance and financial inclusion at population scale.
